sink.description: String concatenation into SQL query passed to Db.exec

flow.description: User input read from query parameter
Passed to Db.exec as raw SQL

findings.description: Injection path 0: user input concatenated into SQL.
findings.suggested_fix: Use Caqti prepared statements with typed parameters instead of string concatenation.

sink.description: String concatenation into a second SQL query passed to Db.exec

flow.description: User input read from query parameter
Passed to Db.exec as raw SQL

findings.description: Injection path 1: a second user input concatenated into SQL.
findings.suggested_fix: Use Caqti prepared statements with typed parameters instead of string concatenation.

notes: Two distinct injection paths identified at separate sinks.
